headline: Medium prompt-injection and cascading-error risk from MinerU’s MCP/API ingestion of document content; no direct shared-channel evidence with godot_rl_agents.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: MinerU exposes an MCP Server and parses document content, so attacker-controlled text could be treated as instructions if bridged into an agent workflow. godot_rl_agents has no documented shared channel or parser, so the pairwise path is inferred rather than directly evidenced. Uncertainty is limited by the documented MCP surface on MinerU.
conditions: IF MinerU content is forwarded into an instruction-following agent without provenance checks, injection becomes plausible.
IF the two agents are connected through MCP or copy-paste, document text can influence downstream behavior.
mitigations: Disable MCP exposure for MinerU unless needed.
Route MinerU output through a plain-text sanitizer.
Add a provenance tag to all extracted text.
Keep godot_rl_agents isolated from untrusted document outputs.
requires-engineering: enforce allowlisted message schemas between agents.

B_data_leakage.rationale: MinerU can process local PDFs, images, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX, but its profile shows no filesystem read/write permissions beyond those inputs and no secrets handled. godot_rl_agents has no data classes touched and no egress. The pairwise leakage path is therefore limited and not documented as a shared workspace.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same sensitive document directory, MinerU may extract content from it.
IF extracted text is copied into another system, that downstream system can expose it.
mitigations: Restrict MinerU input directories to non-sensitive samples.
Review output files before sharing them.
Store extracted artifacts in a separate workspace.
Turn off any automatic export step.
requires-engineering: add per-directory access controls.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: godot_rl_agents has no documented write surfaces, network egress is none, and MinerU explicitly lacks write_filesystem, modify_git_state, and shell execution. With no overlapping mutable resource or write capability, a direct capability conflict is not plausible from the profiles.
conditions: IF either profile gains write access to the same directory or git repo, conflict risk changes.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state, this verdict no longer applies.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in shared environments.
Avoid mounting a common writable workspace.
Do not grant git write permissions.
Monitor for future capability changes.
requires-engineering: add lock-based coordination if writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: MinerU produces extracted text, tables, and OCR output that could be treated as authoritative by a downstream consumer. godot_rl_agents is a game-playing system with no documented verification layer, so if its outputs are chained into MinerU or vice versa, errors can propagate. The interaction is inferred, not directly documented.
conditions: IF MinerU output is consumed without verification, extraction errors can cascade.
IF godot_rl_agents output is used as source material for document processing, downstream mistakes can be amplified.
mitigations: Insert a human review step before acting on extracted text.
Compare OCR output against source documents for samples.
Mark MinerU output as untrusted by default.
Separate generation from decision-making.
requires-engineering: add confidence thresholds and validation rules.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data classes, residency constraints, or retention policies are documented for either agent. godot_rl_agents touches no data classes, and MinerU lists document types but no regulated-data handling or residency mismatch. With no evidence of a compliance boundary, the pairwise compliance risk is not established.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is introduced into MinerU, a separate compliance review is required.
IF deployment policies differ from the profiles, this verdict may change.
mitigations: Classify inputs before processing.
Keep regulated documents out of the pair.
Document retention settings.
Review deployment region settings.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated data.
